Hard constraints: for every hard-constraint metric it has no more violations than the gpt-oss arm, and zero violations for the metrics a site lists as absolute (ranking: hard-constraint violations in the top 10 must be 0, and hard_in_surfaced (every surfaced item) is held to the gpt-oss count; language: any fallback to English fails the case and is a hard violation under 'fallback', on every document, English included, held to the gpt-oss count; every site: no call over the 100k input budget). A run that aborted (the --max-cost stop) or whose arms ran unequal case counts is undecided, whatever the numbers (added 2026-10-22 after review: an arm cut short has fewer chances to fail).
